answer: Warehouse snapshot to cold storage is Hana Sharma's because of 5 sources: log-0002 (joblog), log-0005 (joblog), log-0007 (joblog), log-0009 (joblog), msg-0009 (message).
cypher:
MATCH (d:Duty {id: $duty})-[r:OWNER|HOLDS]->(p:Person {id: $person})
WITH d, p, r, CASE WHEN type(r) = 'HOLDS' THEN r.srcs ELSE [r.rec] END AS refs
UNWIND refs AS ref
MATCH (s:Source {id: ref})
RETURN d.id AS duty, d.name AS name, p.id AS person, type(r) AS via, coalesce(r.belief, r.rec) AS basis,
       s.id AS source, s.type AS type, s.text AS text
ORDER BY source
